answer: Every admission writes a relic naming the harbor whose member invited the key, and keys bearing the same relic form one cluster. Epoch pay is released only after judges in other harbor branches sign the key's work. The n-th key under one relic needs n separate harbor signatures, and each harbor charges 5 sparrow per judgment. An honest newcomer pays 5 sparrow per epoch. 100 clones under one relic pay 25,250 sparrow every epoch, or the operator must bribe a member of a different harbor to invite each clone.
